contexts.tier: Spent200-cell CD4 lineage holdout; public development biology reused
Previously spent400-cell CD4 condition, now development only
contexts.selected_by: Alphabetical target names, counts>=400, matched-control batch support only; one seed and eight targets maximum

architecture.condition: 32 STRING target coordinates +4-or-fewer training-control rank PCs
architecture.loss: Own-masked OT-coupled velocity MSE +1 mean-velocity MSE +0.1 direction cosine (non-null only)

split: Entire H1, entire Orion and entire CD4 excluded. Target-identity20% source validation using V32 hash; no source fitting response for those identities. Source controls reusable. Query conditioning only target identity/embedding and NTC context, consistent with fitting; no observed mean or response descriptor.
mean_gate: Primary MSE<=0.99 and MAE<=0.995, worst-family MSE<=1.02, CPM MSE<=1.02; beat target shuffle on both LFC errors. Count inference is tested regardless on a fixed diagnostic subset; failure cannot advance to release.
counts: All frozen public mean cases; first4 cases/context count diagnostic with actual400 for H1/Orion/Stim and200 for D1. One400-cell null/context. Identical baseline emitter for learned mean; shape25 blends neural profiles with baseline counts before exact-library largest-remainder rounding. Raw Wilcoxon/BH and panel metrics, no private anchors.
limitations: Partial1024-gene pilot; outside modeled axis V24 fallback. K562/RPE1 have pseudobulk inputs here, not raw flow training cells. Matched-lane centering with source controls; OT coupling across centered populations is a modeling device, not observed individual counterfactuals. Reused public biological cases; no new blind lineage.
release: No reserve or package/upload during these tests. Test this model independently of V32/V33 outcomes.
